messages.content: 製作巧克力蛋糕應該準備哪些材料？

message.content:
以下是一份常見的巧克力蛋糕配方所需的基本材料清單（約可做 8-10 塊蛋糕）：

| 材料 | 用量 |
|------|------|
| 中筋麵粉 (All‑purpose flour) | 200 克 |
| 砂糖 (Granulated sugar) | 250 克 |
| 可可粉 (Unsweetened cocoa powder) | 50 克 |
| 泡打粉 (Baking powder) | 1 茶匙 |
| 小蘇打 (Baking soda) | ½ 茶匙 |
| 鹽 (Salt) | ¼ 茶匙 |
| 雞蛋 (Eggs) | 2 顆（大約 100 克） |
| 牛奶 (Milk) | 120 毫升 |
| 植物油 (Vegetable oil) | 120 毫升 |
| 香草精 (Vanilla extract) | 1 茶匙 |
| 熱水或熱咖啡 (Boiling water or strong brewed coffee) | 120 毫升 |

> **備註**  
> - 熱水或熱咖啡可以提升可可味道，並使蛋糕更加濕潤。  
> - 若想要更濃郁的巧克力風味，可在面糊中加入 30–50 克黑巧克力碎片或融化的巧克力。  

這些材料足以製作一個標準的巧克力蛋糕。若你有特殊需求（如無麩質、低糖等），請告訴我，我可以提供相應的替代方案！
message.reasoning:
The user asks in Chinese: "製作巧克力蛋糕應該準備哪些材料？" meaning "What ingredients should I prepare to make chocolate cake?" They want a list of ingredients. There's no mention of temperature or oven type. So we don't need to call the function. Just answer with a list of ingredients.

We can provide a standard chocolate cake ingredient list: flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, salt, eggs, milk, vegetable oil, vanilla extract, boiling water or coffee. Also optional: chocolate chips, etc.

We should respond in Chinese.
